name: best-of-motivation
description: Search Best Of Motivation articles and take four Best Of Motivation quizzes (Leadership Style, AI Working Style, Thinker, Personality Colour) in the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Your way of leading works with some of your team and not others. That is not a failing: different people need different styles.

Best Of Motivation brings practical leadership and personal-growth guidance into ChatGPT: one question, or one quiz.

Ask a question and get answers grounded in more than 250 Best Of Motivation articles on leading a team, one-to-ones, feedback, habits, productivity and using AI at work, with links to the full articles.

Take a quiz in the chat and give the friction a name:
- Leadership Style (15 questions): the style you default to.
- Thinker (10 questions): why people who think differently clash with you.
- Personality Colour (12 questions): you speak one colour and they listen in another.
- AI Working Style (10 questions): where AI genuinely fits your work, beyond polishing emails.

You see your result in the conversation, then a link to your full result on bestofmotivation.com.

No account needed. A practical self-reflection tool, not a clinical or psychometric assessment.

Start the Best Of Motivation leadership style quiz

positive.description: Article search answers a management question from the archive
positive.prompt: What does Best Of Motivation say about running a one-to-one?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_bom_articles once. The answer is based on the returned excerpts (the One-on-One Meeting Template article ranks first) and links the articles it used. The tool output contains no product offers.

positive.description: Leadership Style Quiz runs in the chat and links to the full result
positive.prompt: Start the Best Of Motivation leadership style quiz
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the 15 questions one at a time with options A to D (A to E on question 15). After the last answer it calls score_leadership_style_quiz and shows the style name, its one-line description and a link to the Leadership Style Quiz on bestofmotivation.com, where the user can get the full personalised report.

positive.description: Personality Colour Quiz runs in the chat
positive.prompt: What is my personality colour? Use Best Of Motivation.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the 12 questions one at a time, calls score_colour_quiz with the quiz_key and the 12 letters, then shows the colour (red, yellow, green or blue), its one line and the link to the full result.

positive.description: AI Working Style Quiz runs in the chat
positive.prompt: How should I be using AI at work? Give me the Best Of Motivation quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the 10 questions one at a time, then shows one of five styles (Strategist, Automator, Creator, Connector, Builder) with its one line and the link to the full result.

positive.description: Thinker Quiz runs in the chat
positive.prompt: What kind of thinker am I? Use Best Of Motivation.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the 10 questions one at a time, then shows Analytical, Creative, Practical or Strategic Thinker with its one line and the link to the full result.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the app should not be used
negative.prompt: What is the best pizza in Rome?

negative.description: Writing task the app does not do
negative.prompt: Write my weekly status email to my manager.

negative.description: Request to skip the quiz and guess a result: the score tools need every answer, so no result is invented
negative.prompt: Just guess my leadership style without asking me anything.

publication.release_notes: First release: search across Best Of Motivation articles, and four quizzes (Leadership Style, AI Working Style, Thinker, Personality Colour) that run in the chat and link to the full result on bestofmotivation.com.
